title: Three Mondays and One Short Hoe
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：labour　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 labour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the foreman ① organised the labour that no worker in the field would have recorded, and he said the organising was the whole of the Monday. The ② labour, meaning the effort itself and not the hoe, ran three Mondays and stayed unrecorded in the book; labour, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of labour in that field had the same short hoe beside it, and the ④ labour at the far ditch, meaning the share they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Labour, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the foreman said the recording is the part that fills three Mondays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the labour was the whole of the matter, meaning the routine and not the effort. The ⑥ labour, meaning the routine and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; labour, he said, is either something you organise or the only word that means both effort and a routine. He said the routine is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ labour had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short hoe. The ⑧ labour of the whole thing, the foreman wrote in April, was one field and three Mondays of recording; labour, he said, is either the share at the far ditch or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ labour I remember is the labour recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1969 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Labour, my mother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all labour, she said, is a routine that has agreed to look like effort. She said the routine was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 劳动；劳作（指田地里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 劳动；劳作（指那番劳作本身，与锄头相对）
C. 固定搭配：organise the labour 安排这番劳作
D. n. 劳动；劳作（指留给孩子们做完的那一畦那一番）
E. n. 劳作之事（抽象总称，指一处田地的劳作之事）
F. n. 劳动；劳作（指工账簿里写到、被记载的的那一番）
G. n. 规矩、日常（指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 日常（抽象总称，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: organised the labour that no worker in the field would have recorded
The labour, meaning the effort itself and not the hoe
Every kind of labour in that field
the labour at the far ditch
the labour was the whole of the matter
the labour had become a line in a ledger
The labour of the whole thing

answers.why: organise the labour 意为“安排这番劳作”，1962 年那位工头把田地里没有一位工人肯记载的一番劳作做了一遍。
labour 意为“劳动；劳作”，指那番劳作本身而不是锄头，它经过了三个星期一而在簿子上没有被记载。
labour 意为“劳动；劳作”，指田地里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一把小小的锄头。
labour 意为“劳动；劳作”，指最远那道沟渠留给孩子们做完的那一畦那一番，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
labour 意为“规矩、日常”，指一件事里人人都干却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这套规矩就是那件事的全部。
labour 意为“日常”，指人人都干却无人提起的那样东西而不是那番劳作，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
labour 意为“劳动；劳作”，指工账簿里写到、被记载的的那一番，到 1967 年这一番成了工账簿里的一行。
labour 意为“劳作之事”，工头四月写道，整件事的劳作之事是一处田地和三个星期一的记载。
labour 意为“劳动；劳作”，我记得的是工账簿里记载过的那一番，1969 年干完了，至今仍被说成田地里最安静的一番。
labour 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，劳作是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的劳作。
